headlines.title: Democrats Maintain Narrow Lead in Mississippi and Alaska
headlines.description: Democrats are hoping their blue tsunami will reach even farther into GOP territory with their senate candidates narrowly leading in deep-red Mississippi and Alaska, but the too-close-to-call races may take days or even weeks to resolve. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Stocks Plunge Amid AI Fears and Political Uncertainty
headlines.description: The S&P 500 and the NASDAQ had their worst day Thursday since April 2025, with tech stocks and companies tied to AI among the biggest losers. Investors say it’s all about the uncertainty over how a Democratically-controlled Congress will work with President Donald Trump. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after commission’s approval
headlines.description: The Trump administration has said it expects to begin construction immediately, but a judge is considering a plan to temporarily halt the project.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth strikes defiant tone in face of impeachment threat
headlines.description: Many lawmakers, including some Republicans, have criticized the defense secretary over his handling of the Iran war.

headlines.title: NBC News producer shares personal journey battling Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: Senior Coordinating Producer Sue Kroll travels the world covering the news, but tonight she shares her own story about her battle to fend off Alzheimer’s and the steps she’s taking to avoid the brutal disease. NBC News’ Senior National Correspondent Kate Snow reports Sue’s story.

headlines.title: Martha Stewart Addresses Halloween Costume Controversy
headlines.description: After days of backlash following her Halloween costume as a homeless person, Martha Stewart sits down with TODAY’s Craig Melvin to address the controversy. “I’m aware of all those social issues…and I care desperately about all the problems facing us, but I made a mistake. I was stupid,” she said. She also apologizes to Craig for claiming him spilling chocolate on her earlier caused the last-minute costume change, saying it was “a joke.”

headlines.title: Anthony Ippolito on Channeling Sylvester Stallone for ‘I Play Rocky’
headlines.description: “I Play Rocky” star Anthony Ippolito joins TODAY to share the biggest challenge he faced taking on the role of Sylvester Stallone and shares how the legendary actor reacted to the film.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Affording America: The rising costs of family farming
headlines.description: Javier Zamora achieved his dream of starting his own family farm and watching his customer base grow, but as the costs of labor, chemicals, and diesel have risen, his profit margins have continued to fall.

headlines.title: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, a bright spot for the economy
headlines.description: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, a surprisingly strong number that includes what appear to be some AI-related construction and manufacturing jobs.

headlines.title: LeBron James took a risk going to the 76ers this offseason. So far, it’s paying off.
headlines.description: James, who switched teams for the fourth time in free agency over the summer, has helped lead the Philadelphia 76ers to the hottest start in the NBA.
